final: WITH overall_stats AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) as overall_avg FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL), patient_avg_hgb AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) as patient_avg_hgb FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), above_average_patients AS (SELECT p.ID, p.patient_avg_hgb FROM patient_avg_hgb p, overall_stats o WHERE p.patient_avg_hgb > o.overall_avg), above_average_avg AS (SELECT AVG(patient_avg_hgb) as avg_of_above_avg FROM above_average_patients) SELECT a.ID, a.patient_avg_hgb, a.patient_avg_hgb - o.overall_avg as above_overall, a.patient_avg_hgb - aa.avg_of_above_avg as minus_above_avg_average FROM above_average_patients a, overall_stats o, above_average_avg aa ORDER BY minus_above_avg_average DESC LIMIT 10
